summary: First end-to-end test of Mana Ooru MVP (backend + Expo web frontend). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass through the public URL — all locations, emergency, businesses (health/transport/government + pharmacy filter), updates, AI /search endpoint (returns intent.section='health' with pharmacy results), and no MongoDB _id leaks. Frontend: onboarding 3 steps, home, emergency, health (chips + business cards with Call/Directions), search, More tab and Settings all render and are navigable on 390x844 mobile viewport. Language toggle to Telugu works on both onboarding and settings. Only one missing testID and a few minor UI observations.

ui_bugs.issue: testID 'home-search-submit' is MISSING in DOM. All other home-* testIDs are present. Search still functions because pressing Enter in the input navigates to /search?q=..., but the spec explicitly requires a tappable submit button with this testID.

issues: Telugu glyphs on the Welcome screen render with visible character gaps / broken conjuncts on web (e.g. 'మన ఊరుకు నీవగ త'). This is likely a missing Telugu web font — the same text renders fine on Settings/Emergency screens where system fonts are used. Consider bundling a Telugu-capable font (Noto Sans Telugu) via expo-font for the branded title/tagline.

Card labelled 'Blood Help · 104' is shown in the UI, but 104 is not a national blood helpline number and there is no 'blood' entry in the EMERGENCY_SEED (only ambulance/police/fire/women/child/disaster). Number appears to be hard-coded in the emergency screen — please verify and cite an official source or remove.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeated many times: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow or Platform.select for future RN Web versions.

action_items: Add testID='home-search-submit' to the submit/search icon button next to the search input on the Home screen (currently missing while all other home-* testIDs exist).
Fix Telugu font rendering on the Welcome onboarding screen — bundle Noto Sans Telugu (or similar) via expo-font and apply to the branded title/tagline text styles.
Verify the 'Blood Help · 104' emergency card: 104 is not a standard national helpline. Either back it with a real seeded contact or remove/replace it (e.g. link to 108 for blood emergencies).
Migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' (or use Platform.select) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PROJECTION correctly excludes _id — verified by tests. Good.
server.py: /search fallback to rule-based intent when LLM fails is well-implemented; response schema is stable.
server.py: seed_if_empty runs on startup and is idempotent. Good.
Emergency helpline numbers should be sourced from the /api/emergency endpoint rather than hard-coded in emergency.tsx (the 'Blood Help · 104' entry is not in the seed).
seed_data_creation: None — backend seed_if_empty already populated locations, emergency, businesses, updates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable; focus on: (1) confirming home-search-submit testID renders and is tappable, (2) Telugu font fix on Welcome screen, (3) Blood/104 emergency card resolution. Onboarding data is stored in AsyncStorage; to reach Home directly use /(tabs) after completing onboarding once, or clear storage to re-test onboarding.
